name: Aster MIMS Calicut
summary: Aster MIMS Calicut is a 600-bed multispeciality hospital on Mini By-pass Road in Kozhikode, part of the Aster hospitals network. It gives the network a large referral hospital in northern Kerala.
highlights: Centres for cardiac sciences, neurosciences, orthopaedics, gastro sciences and child health
Multi-organ transplant programme, including liver transplant
Part of the Aster hospitals network, like Aster Medcity in Kochi
